preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 20 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 200000 for N in test_case_Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nodes N is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Q <= 200000 for Q in test_case_Qs)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of queries Q is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= val <= 100 for val in A) for A in test_case_As)
preconditions.description: For each test case, every node value A_i is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges) for edges, N in zip(test_case_edges, test_case_Ns))
preconditions.description: For each test case, every edge connects two distinct valid nodes u and v within the range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N and a != b for a, b in queries) for queries, N in zip(test_case_queries, test_case_Ns))
preconditions.description: For each test case, every query specifies two distinct valid nodes a and b within the range [1, N].
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500,000.
The sum of Q over all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 and is_tree(N, edges) for N, edges in zip(test_case_Ns, test_case_edges))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the edges form a valid tree structure with N nodes and N-1 edges.

postconditions.description: The total number of output lines equals the total number of queries across all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(is_valid_path_min_diff(query_idx, a, b, N, A, edges, output_val) for query_idx, (a, b, N, A, edges, output_val) in enumerate(zip(flattened_queries, flattened_Ns, flattened_As, flattened_edges, flattened_outputs)))
postconditions.description: For each query (a, b) in a test case, the output value is the minimum absolute difference |A_x - A_y| for all distinct pairs x, y on the simple path between a and b in the tree.
